item.title: BBC joins paramedics on duty in Lebanon after Israeli strikes
item.summary: BBC Middle East correspondent Hugo Bachega joins paramedics on duty in Nabatieh - a city that was once vibrant, but is now abandoned.

item.title: This blockade is a gamble. Will it work?
item.summary: The US military is gambling on the blockade denying Iran vital trade - but questions remain on whether the bet will pay off.

item.title: Israelis war-weary but most oppose Iran ceasefire, poll suggests
item.summary: The vast majority did not believe Hezbollah or Iran had been severely weakened by weeks of Israeli and US attacks, according to the poll.

item.title: Tracking the ships crossing the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: The first vessel has crossed the Strait of Hormuz after the US imposed a military blockade of Iran's ports.

item.title: Trump threat to Iranian civilians 'wrong', Starmer says
item.summary: The PM condemns the US president's threat that a "whole civilisation" would die unless Iran agreed to end the war.

item.title: Israel steps up strikes on Lebanon and Hezbollah attacks continue as talks loom
item.summary: More than 160 people have been killed since Friday in Lebanon, where Israel is pressing on with its campaign against Hezbollah despite the US-Iran ceasefire.

item.title: Iran carried out highest number of executions in decades
item.summary: Organisations warn many more people could be executed in the wake of the anti-government protests which swept Iran earlier this year.

item.title: French cement giant guilty of financing IS and other militant groups in Syria
item.summary: The French company paid $6.5m to jihadist groups to keep its plant running in war-torn Syria, a Paris court heard.

item.title: Palestinian shot dead during Israeli settler attack on occupied West Bank village
item.summary: The killing came as ex-security chiefs warned "government sponsored Jewish terrorism" was out of control.

item.title: Ceasefire or no ceasefire, the Middle East's reshuffling is not yet done
item.summary: Both sides have reason to end the war but share no common ground.
